Veterans Day falls on Wednesday, Nov. 11, 2026, and restaurants across the country will show their appreciation by offering special deals and free meals for military members and veterans.

Blue Star Families editorial team tracks the latest free meals, discounts and savings opportunities for military families to celebrate Veterans Day while saving some money when they go out to eat. 

Keep in mind that most chains publish their official Veterans Day details between late October and early November, and offers vary by location. Call your local restaurant before you go, bring proof of service, and expect terms to change. This guide will be updated as restaurants confirm their 2026 offers.

MORE: Veterans Day Deals and Discounts on Retail and Services

Veterans Day Free Meals and Restaurant Discounts

  • Applebee’s: Each year, Applebee’s offers a free full-size entree from a special Veterans Day menu. Last year’s menu included a top sirloin, bacon cheeseburger and chicken tenders platter options for dine-in only. Last year’s offer also included a surprise, a free $5 Bounce Back Card for use Nov. 12-29. 
  • Aroma Joe’s: Aroma Joe’s locations across the chain offer service members and veterans a free 24 oz. drink or an AJ’s RUSH Energy Drink 24 with valid identification, according to a company release.
  • Aspen Creek Grill: From 11 a.m. to 6 p.m. on Veterans Day, Aspen Creek Grill hands out $15 vouchers to service members and veterans who show valid identification. The vouchers are valid through Dec. 24, 2026.
  • Backyard Taco: On Wednesday, Nov. 11, all seven Backyard Taco locations in Arizona offer veterans and military members a complimentary meal worth up to $15 on any menu items, with guests only having to pay the difference on larger orders, according to a company release.
  • Bad Daddy’s Burger Bar: On Veterans Day, Bad Daddy’s offers a free burger with cheese and a side from 11 a.m. to 3 p.m., dine-in only.
  • Biscuit Belly: On Nov. 11, Biscuit Belly offers military members and veterans a free drip coffee and biscuit sandwich. Options include a chicken biscuit, a bacon, egg and cheese biscuit, or a sausage, egg and cheese biscuit, according to the brand.
  • Blaze Pizza: Participating Blaze Pizza locations offer military members a free one-topping pizza on Veterans Day, according to a company release. According to comments, some franchises may not participate, so call your local franchise ahead before you visit to be sure!
  • Bob Evans: Active duty military members, veterans, National Guard and reserve service members can choose a free entree from a special Bob Evans menu of 11 options on Veterans day. The menu includes both breakfast and lunch or dinner meal options, so you can visit any time to celebrate Veterans Day! This year, each guest will also receive a coupon for a free cup of sausage gravy and biscuits to use on a future visit, according to an announcement by Bob Evans communications team.
  • Bombshells: On Wednesday, Nov. 11, all Bombshells locations in Texas and Colorado offer veterans and military members a free meal, including an appetizer, entree and dessert. Family members dining with them will also receive a 20% discount, according to a company release. Bring a form of military or veteran ID, such as a uniformed services or retired ID, leave and earnings statement, a VFW or American Legion card or a DD-214.
  • Buca di Beppo: On Wednesday, Nov. 11, from 11 a.m. to 3 p.m., Buca di Beppo offers veterans and military members one free lunch salad, pasta or entree at all U.S. restaurants, dine-in only, with a valid military ID or proof of service, according to a company release. Reservations are strongly encouraged!
  • Buffalo’s Cafe: On Nov. 11, participating Buffalo’s Cafe locations offer veterans and active-duty military members 25% off their meal, dine-in only and excluding alcohol, with proof of military status, according to a release from the chain’s parent company, OHG Brands.
  • Buffalo Wild Wings: Each year, Buffalo Wild Wings offers its annual “Wings for Heroes” promotion on Nov. 11. During the promotion, all service members and veterans with valid ID can receive a free order of 10 boneless wings.
  • California Pizza Kitchen: On Wednesday, Nov. 11, 2026, California Pizza Kitchen will celebrated Veterans Day with a complimentary meal and beverage from a select menu. Guests who dine in will also receive a buy-one-get-one coupon for another pizza, pasta or salad to redeem before Nov. 25, 2026, according to a CPK release.
  • California Tortilla: On Veterans Day, California Tortilla offers veterans a free order of chips and queso with any purchase at all locations with valid military identification, according to a communications representative for the brand.
  • Capriotti’s Sandwich Shop: On Veterans Day, Capriotti’s Sandwich Shop offers veterans and active-duty military members a free small sub with a valid military ID, according to a communications representative for the brand.
  • Casey’s General Store: On Veterans Day, Casey’s store locations offer a free coffee or fountain drink with valid military identification or proof of service. 
  • Chick-fil-A: Chick-fil-A stores are franchises, which means each business sets special offers and discount events differently. However, many locations participate in special Veterans Day offers each year, including free meals, entrees or Military Appreciation Nights. 
  • Chili’s: On Nov. 11, Chili’s is offering a free meal from a special Veterans Day menu for veterans and active duty military members who dine-in. Meal options include Chicken Crispers, Chicken Bacon Ranch Quesadillas, an Oldtimer Burger with Cheese, or soup and a house salad. 
  • Chipotle: On Nov. 11, Chipotle is offering free chips and dip with a $5 minimum in-restaurant purchase to veterans and military members who show proof of service. Dip options include guac, Queso Blanco or salsa. The free item, taxes and tips don’t count toward the $5.
  • The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf: Last year, The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf offered a free drink for veterans, active-duty members and spouses, according to the company’s social media. Check back closer to Veterans Day for this year’s details!
  • Cotton Patch Cafe: On Nov. 11, Cotton Patch Cafe offers military members and retirees a free small or regular Chicken Fried Steak or Chicken Fried Chicken at participating locations. The offer is dine-in only, with no takeout or delivery, and requires a military ID or other proof of service.
  • Cracker Barrel: This year, Cracker Barrel offers service members and veterans a free Sunrise Pancake Special with valid identification, according to a company release. according to a company release. The company is also offering 25% off its Military Collection merchandise through Nov. 12, in-store and online. They also provide a year-round 10% off military discount when you verify your service in the Cracker Barrel app. 
  • Dave & Buster’s: On Nov. 11, Dave & Buster’s offers veterans and active military members free all-day Unlimited Game Play and/or a free dessert with a qualifying entree, depending on the location. Unlimited Game Play covers blue and green swipe games only and excludes VR, crane, pusher, dance and merchandising games.
  • Denny’s: This year, Denny’s locations offer a free meal, such as an Original Grand Slam, for veterans and military members who present a valid ID on Veterans Day, according to a company release.
  • Dickey’s Barbecue Pit: On Wednesday, Nov. 11, 2026, Dickey’s Barbecue Pit locations offer military members and veterans a free pulled pork sandwich to celebrate Veterans Day.
  • Dunkin’: Each year on Veterans Day, Dunkin offers service members and veterans a free donut when purchasing in-store. 
  • Dunn Brothers Coffee: Dunn Brothers Coffee offers active duty and retired military members and veterans a free small brewed coffee or cold brew with a valid military ID at participating locations, according to a spokesperson for the brand.
  • Escalante’s: Escalante’s offers veterans a free side of queso with any purchase and a valid military ID, according to a brand communications representative.
  • Fat Rosie’s: Fat Rosie’s offers veterans 50% off entrees for dine-in guests with a valid veterans ID, according to the brand’s communications team.
  • Fazoli’s: On Nov. 11, participating Fazoli’s locations offer veterans and active-duty military members a free spaghetti with marinara or meat sauce with code VET26 and proof of military status, according to a release from parent company OHG Brands. No purchase is necessary.
  • Firebirds Wood Fired Grill: On Veterans Day and during Armed Forces Week in May, Firebirds Wood Fired Grill offers a free meal for veterans and military members. 
  • Food City: On Nov. 11, Food City grocery delis offer veterans and active military members a free hot bar meal (an entree, two sides and a roll) and a 21-ounce fountain drink, up to $9.98 in value, from 10 a.m. to 9 p.m. Guests need military ID or proof of service and a ValuCard. Details here.
  • Freddy’s Frozen Custard & Steakburgers: On Veterans Day, Freddy’s gives a free combo meal card to veterans and active service members, redeemable through Nov. 25, 2026.
  • Friendly’s: Each year on Veterans Day, Friendly’s has offered a free burger entree and beverage to service members and veterans who present valid military ID.
  • Golden Corral: Golden Corral’s 26th annual Military Appreciation Night offers a free dinner buffet and beverage to anyone who has served, including active duty, National Guard and reserve service members, veterans and military retirees. The offer runs from 4 p.m. to close on Wednesday, Nov. 11, and is dine-in only, with no takeout and no rain checks. Non-military guests pay regular prices.
  • The Greene Turtle: The Greene Turtle offers a free meal worth up to $15 on Veterans Day, along with a standing 15% military discount that service members can use throughout the year with valid military identification. 
  • Hooters: On Wednesday, Nov. 11, participating Hooters locations offer veterans one free item with a drink purchase: 10 Original wings, a cheeseburger, a Buffalo chicken sandwich or a Chicken Caesar salad. Sides are excluded, and menu items vary by location, according to a company page. Bring valid ID or proof of service when you visit.
  • Hopdoddy Burger Bar: On Wednesday, Nov. 11, Hopdoddy offers veterans and active-duty military members a free Classic Burger or Classic Burger with Cheese at all locations, dine-in only, with proof of service.
  • Huddle House: Huddle House offers active and retired military members a free Original French Toast with a valid military ID at any location during posted operating hours. The offer is dine-in only, according to a brand representative.
  • Hurricane Grill & Wings: On Nov. 11, participating Hurricane Grill & Wings locations offer veterans and active-duty military members one complimentary dine-in entree, such as wings, fish and chips, a Steakburger, a chicken Caesar salad, a crispy chicken sandwich or chicken BLT tacos, with proof of military status, according to a release from parent company OHG Brands.
  • Hy-Vee: On Veterans Day, Hy-Vee stores host a free breakfast from 6 to 10 a.m., at stores with hot food, plus 15% off groceries purchased in-store or online with code VETS2026 on Nov. 11! 
  • IHOP: Each year, IHOP offers a free “Red, White & Blue(berry)” pancake combo with eggs, hash browns and bacon or sausage, from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m., in-store only. Service members and veterans are eligible for the offer with a valid military or veteran identification card or a DD-214. 
  • Keke’s Breakfast Cafe: On Nov. 11 only, participating Keke’s Breakfast Cafe locations offer veterans and active and retired military members a free Classic Two Egg Combo, with two eggs, home fries or grits, and toast or an English muffin, according to a company release. The offer is dine-in only, requires a valid military ID or proof of service, and is limited to one per eligible guest. No purchase is required.
  • Kolache Factory: On Veterans Day, Kolache Factory offers veterans a free kolache and coffee. The chain also offers a standing 10% military discount that veterans and military members can use throughout the year with a military ID or DD-214. 
  • Kona Grill: From Nov. 9 to 11, participating Kona Grill locations offer veterans, service members and Gold Star Families one free entree with the purchase of any starter. Entree options include Pad Thai Noodles, Macadamia Nut Chicken, Kona Stir-Fry or Lemon Garlic Penne. Details here.
  • Little Caesars: On Nov. 11, from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m., participating Little Caesars locations offer veterans and active-duty military members a free HOT-N-READY Lunch Combo, four slices of Detroit-style deep dish pizza and a 20-ounce Pepsi, with a military or veteran ID, according to a company release.
  • Logan’s Roadhouse: On Wednesday, Nov. 11, participating corporate-owned Logan’s Roadhouse locations offer veterans and active duty military members one free entree from a Veterans Day menu when they dine-in from 11 a.m. to 3 p.m, according to a release from the steakhouse chain. Menu Options include an All-American Cheeseburger, Hand-Breaded Chicken Tenders, Chopped Steak, a BBQ Grilled Pork Chop or Steak Tips.
  • Lucille’s Smokehouse Bar-B-Que: On Nov. 11, Lucille’s offers veterans and active-duty military members a complimentary Pulled Pork Sandwich or Personal-Size Southern Fried Chicken, dine-in only, with a valid military ID, according to a company release.
  • Macayo’s Mexican Restaurants: On Wednesday, Nov. 11, Macayo’s restaurants will offer veterans a free a la carte chimichanga with shredded beef, shredded chicken or bean filling at any location, for dine-in or takeout. Show a valid military ID when ordering, according to a company release. The restaurant chain also offers a standing 10% military discount, year-round.
  • Main Event: On Nov. 11, Main Event offers military members and veterans a free Double Cheeseburger and Fries plus 30 minutes of free gameplay with a valid ID. Gameplay timecards exclude crane and prize games. Main Event also offers a year-round 10% discount on food, non-alcoholic beverages, activities, video games and bowling shoe rentals for military personnel, first responders and up to five guests.
  • Max & Erma’s: On Nov. 11, Max & Erma’s offers service members and veterans a free cheeseburger, fries and fountain drink with proof of service.
  • McCormick & Schmick’s: McCormick & Schmick’s offers a select half-priced entree for veterans and service members who dine-in o Sunday, Nov. 8, 2026, ahead of Veterans Day.
  • MOOYAH Burgers, Fries & Shakes: MOOYAH Rewards members who buy a burger and a Shareable Fry can get a second burger free at participating locations. The offer is available to all guests through the Rewards app, according to a brand representative. New app users who download the app and register on Nov. 11 can receive the offer that same day.
  • Native Grill & Wings: On Nov. 11, participating Native Grill & Wings locations offer veterans and active-duty military members a free dine-in meal, such as a half-pound Stripper Combo, a half-pound Boneless Combo, a #MyNative Burger with fries or a Native Chicken Sandwich with fries, with proof of military status, according to a release from the brand’s parent company.
  • Off The Hook Restaurants: On Nov. 11, all Off The Hook locations offer veterans and active-duty military members a free shrimp platter with fries, hushpuppies and Hook Sauce, according to a company release.
  • Olive Garden: Each year, Olive garden offers a free entree from a select menu to service members and veterans with valid military ID or proof of service. Entree options usually include some of Olive Garden’s most popular dishes, including Spaghetti and meatballs, fettuccine Alfredo, chicken parmigiana or the restaurant’s unlimited soup, salad and breadsticks option!
  • Outback Steakhouse: From Nov. 10-11, 2026, Outback Steakhouse offers veterans and military members who dine in a free ‘Bloomin’ Onion’ appetizer and a beverage, including a fountain drink or a non-craft domestic draft beer, according to the chain’s communications team. The select menu includes a starter, an entree and a desert. In addition to the Veterans day deal, Outback Steakhouse also offers a standing 10% “Heroes discount” for military members, veterans and first responders. Outback Steakhouse Dine Rewards members can also get one free Hero’s Meal, redeemable Nov. 16, 2026, through May 2, 2027.
  • Perkins Restaurant & Bakery: Perkins offers military members and veterans a free Magnificent Seven Breakfast Meal with a valid military ID at participating locations, according to a Perkins communications representative.
  • Perry’s Steakhouse & Grille: On Wednesday, Nov. 11, from 4 p.m. to close, Perry’s offers veterans and military members a free dinner-cut pork chop when a paying guest orders a full-priced dinner entree, or a three-course $39 Military Menu, dine-in only with a reservation required. Veterans dining alone or with other veterans can purchase the pork chop at half price, according to the chain’s website.
  • Pilot Flying J: On Nov. 11, Pilot Flying J offers veterans and active duty military members a free breakfast sandwich and coffee, or a lunch item and fountain drink, at participating Pilot and Flying J locations. Claim the by verifying your military service in the Pilot app.
  • Prince St. Pizza: On Nov. 11, Prince St. Pizza offers veterans and military members a free slice at all locations, with a valid military ID or proof of service. The chain will also donate 10% of in-store sales at participating locations to the American Red Cross Service to the Armed Forces program.
  • Qdoba: On Veterans Day, Qdoba offers free chips and dip for veterans and service members who dine-in and show valid military or veteran identification, according to the chain’s website.
  • Raising Cane’s: On Veterans Day and every day, Raising Cane’s offers a 10% military discount for service members and veterans, and 10% off for first responders. The chain has also participated in charitable campaigns around Veterans Day in the past.
  • Red Lobster: On Veterans Day, Red Lobster offers a free, hand-breaded shrimp and chips entree to service members and veterans with valid identification. 
  • Red Robin: On Wednesday, Nov. 11, Red Robin offers veterans and active duty military members a free Red’s Big Tavern Burger with Bottomless Steak Fries at participating locations, dine-in only and with no purchase needed. Guests need a valid military ID or other proof of service. The offer excludes modifications and other burger styles.
  • Ruby Tuesday: On Nov. 11, Ruby Tuesday offers U.S. veterans and military members who show valid identification a free Everyday Fresh Meal, an entree with the Garden Bar and a bottomless drink, worth up to $17.99, at participating locations.
  • Santa Fe Cattle Co.: Santa Fe Cattle Co. locations offer a free Lunch Express entree to military members and veterans on Nov. 11 to celebrate Veterans Day. 
  • Scooter’s Coffee: This year, Scooter’s Coffee offers veterans and military members a free medium handcrafted drink, including holiday drinks, with valid military or veteran ID.
  • Shake Shack: Last year, Shake Shack offered a free Big Shack for service members and veterans who dine-in at a Shake Shack restaurant, according to the company’s website. Check back later for more details on this year’s offer!
  • Shoney’s: On Nov. 11, Shoney’s offers veterans and military members a free Breakfast Fresh Food Bar until 11 a.m. at participating locations.
  • Sizzler: Sizzler will offered a free lunch entree until 4 p.m. at participating locations, according to Sizzler’s website.
  • Smashburger: For Veterans Day 2026, Smashburger offers veterans and service members a free All-American Smash burger or American Big Dog on Nov. 11.
  • Sonny’s BBQ: On Nov. 11, Sonny’s BBQ offers veterans and military members a free Pork Big Deal, a pulled or sliced pork sandwich with a Sidekick and a drink, with any valid military ID or proof of service.
  • Starbucks: On Nov. 11, veterans, active-duty military members and military spouses can get a free tall hot or iced coffee of their choice at participating Starbucks locations. The offer doesn’t cover size or ingredient upgrades. Learn more about the Starbucks Veterans Day deal here.
  • Sullivan’s Steakhouse: Last year, Sullivan’s Steakhouse offered a free Angus Burger and fries, to military members and veterans with valid identification. Check the chain’s promotions page for details applicable to your local restaurant!
  • Taziki’s Mediterranean Cafe: As part of its annual Gyros for Heroes celebration, participating Taziki’s locations offer veterans a free Grilled Chicken Gyro meal, with chips and a side, on Wednesday, Nov. 11, according to a company release.
  • TCBY: On Nov. 11, TCBY offers veterans and active military members one free 6-ounce frozen yogurt with a valid military ID. Guests pay for any weight over 6 ounces, and the offer varies by store.
  • Teriyaki Madness: To celebrate Veterans Day, Teriyaki Madness locations will offer service members and veterans a free junior or regular sized bowl, according to the chain’s website. The promotion lists specific participating locations, so check the list here before heading over to eat. 
  • Tijuana Flats: Veterans and active-duty military members with valid ID can get 50% off an adult entree for in-store orders with a minimum purchase of $9.99, according to a brand spokesperson. Guests must mention the discount code, VETDAY26 at checkout. The discount applies to the lowest-priced adult entree on the check.
  • VIVA Chicken: On Nov. 11, VIVA Chicken offers veterans and military members a complimentary entree with the purchase of another qualifying entree at participating locations in the Carolinas and Utah.
  • Wienerschnitzel: On Nov. 11, participating Wienerschnitzel locations offer a free Original Chili Dog, small fries and small soda with a military ID or when you wear your uniform, according to the company’s website. The offer is limited to one per guest, and cheese and tax cost extra.
  • Wendy’s: On Nov. 11, participating U.S. Wendy’s restaurants offer veterans and active-duty military members one free Dave’s Single with no purchase needed, according to a company blog post. The offer excludes digital, delivery and kiosk orders and can’t be combined with other offers.
  • World of Beer: On Nov. 11, World of Beer offers a free Single Smash Burger and fries to veterans and military members with a military ID or VA card. The offer is for in-store guests only, with one per customer.
